newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade slow at $67 - USDA - 24 April.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade slow at $67 - USDA - 24 April.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers was $1.00 per cwt lower.

Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 700 slaughter steers and 1,500 heifers; 91,000 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 8 loads or 300 head CME cattle delivered to area packing plants, 15,000 head formulated and 800 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 67.00.
Wk to date - 91,000 Week Ago - 100,200 Year Ago - 86,200
